purpose: Test one representative from each of five genuinely new mathematical families without parameter optimization or post-hoc combination search.

common_contract.universe: frozen Malaysia U2 for breadth and U3 for investable primary results
common_contract.point_in_time_warning: Current evidence remains research-only and cannot be promoted without a clean terminal holdout and vendor-grade historical security master checks.
common_contract.position_lag: Signals must use information observable before the stated entry price; no same-close execution from a close-derived signal.
common_contract.cost_model: Use the frozen Malaysia base and stress cost assumptions already registered in the lifetime vault; gap and pairs strategies must add strategy-specific open and borrow stress where stated.
common_contract.portfolio_weighting: Equal weight across selected names or pairs; cash is residual; leverage is prohibited except the explicitly research-only gross-neutral pairs arm.

hypotheses.claim: Positive medium-horizon price moves accompanied by unusually high lagged volume contain more persistent information than price momentum alone.
hypotheses.source_heading: SEEKING PROFITS THROUGH PRICE AND VOLUME
hypotheses.signal_formula: At each Friday close t, r21_i,t is the adjusted-close return from t-21 through t-1. avol_i,t is log(max(volume_i,t-1,1)/max(adv_60_local_lag1_i,t,1)). Cross-sectionally winsorize r21 and avol at 2.5%/97.5%, z-score each, and set score_i,t=z(r21_i,t)*max(z(avol_i,t),0).
hypotheses.primary_comparison: frozen price-only 21-session momentum formula evaluated on the identical calendar and universe

hypotheses.claim: Within the already-liquid U3 universe, stocks with higher lagged Amihud illiquidity earn a positive premium after conservative capacity and transaction-cost constraints.
hypotheses.source_heading: THE ILLIQUIDITY PREMIUM IN ASSET PRICES
hypotheses.signal_formula: At each month-end close t, winsorize log(amihud_60_lag1_i,t) at 2.5%/97.5% across valid U3 names and use its cross-sectional rank as the score.
hypotheses.primary_comparison: zero net alpha after the frozen Malaysia cost model

hypotheses.claim: The equal-weight U3 Malaysia portfolio earns a disproportionate positive return from the final trading session of each month through the third trading session of the next month.
hypotheses.source_file: Quant_Lib/(Wiley Trading) Perry J. Kaufman - Trading Systems and Methods, + Website-Wiley (2013).md
hypotheses.signal_formula: Hold an equal-weight U3 portfolio only from the close immediately before the last exchange session of a month through the close of the third exchange session of the following month; hold cash otherwise. Determine session numbers exclusively from the frozen exchange calendar.
hypotheses.primary_comparison: equal-weight U3 return outside the preregistered turn-of-month window

hypotheses.claim: Industry-restricted price pairs that pass a fixed cointegration screen exhibit subsequent spread convergence after conservative trading and borrow-cost stress.
hypotheses.signal_formula: On the first exchange session of each calendar year, use only the prior 504 sessions. Within pre-existing industry groups, test all pairs with at least 95% joint observations using Engle-Granger at 1%; apply Benjamini-Hochberg FDR 5% within that annual screen; rank survivors by smallest residual half-life; take at most five non-overlapping pairs using ticker SHA-256 as the final tie-breaker. Estimate one hedge ratio on the same formation window. Enter gross-neutral convergence when the lagged spread z-score at a close is at least +2 or at most -2; exit at the first subsequent close with absolute z-score at most 0.5 or after 63 sessions.
hypotheses.primary_comparison: zero net alpha after base costs plus a fixed 300 bps annualized borrow-fee stress on every short leg

hypotheses.claim: The most negative cross-sectional opening gaps in liquid Malaysia stocks partially reverse between the executable open and the same-day close after open-auction slippage.
hypotheses.source_file: Quant_Lib/(Wiley Trading) Perry J. Kaufman - Trading Systems and Methods, + Website-Wiley (2013).md
hypotheses.source_heading: A Simple Gap Trading Method for Stocks
hypotheses.signal_formula: At each valid exchange open t, exclude bad OHLC rows and names without the prior close. Rank the observed open-to-prior-adjusted-close gap across U3. Buy the bottom 20% most negative gaps at the open and liquidate at the same-day close; equal weight selected names. The gap uses the observed open, never the close.
hypotheses.primary_comparison: zero net intraday alpha after frozen costs plus 10 bps one-way open-auction slippage stress

validation.regime_gate: positive net IR in at least four of six frozen Malaysia regimes and worst-regime IR above -1.0
validation.stress_gate: positive net IR under the frozen stress cost model plus strategy-specific stress
validation.u2_breadth_gate: positive U2 net IR where the signal is defined for long-only equities
validation.factor_residual_gate: positive factor-residual IR and alpha t-stat above 2.0
validation.selection_bias_gate: every attempted computation, including engineering-complete nulls, enters the lifetime ledger

twenty_role_advisory.advisory_question: Identify fatal leakage, dependence, multiplicity, numerical, causal, portfolio, capacity, microstructure, or execution defects in the exact five-hypothesis protocol. Recommend rejection or the minimum design-only repair. Do not propose parameter search, alternative signs, additional strategies, or use unseen results.
